hotels.title: North Bali Beachfront Oasis with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner, Cocktails & Dolphin Tour
hotels.description: Embrace sun-kissed tranquillity at this secluded haven, nestled between shimmering blue waters and lush greenery in northern Bali’s Lovina Beach. Boasting its very own stretch of private beach, and just moments away from famous dolphin-watching spots, this tropical resort is barefoot bliss at its finest. Take a dip in the sprawling pool, take to the water with stand-up paddleboarding or snorkelling, or keep active with morning yoga classes. Sample the region’s finest local produce at Heliconia Restaurant overlooking the local rice paddies or sip expertly crafted poolside cocktails at the Sunset Bar. Bali’s northern coast beckons with a plethora of experiences waiting to be discovered, and with the hotel’s complimentary shuttle service within Lovina Town - plus an included guided tour covering local, easily missed hot springs and Buddhist temples - exploration is made easy. Delve into the rich tapestry of culture in the nearby port town of Singaraja or marvel at the majestic cascades of Gitgit village’s waterfalls.
